pages.title: Starter Kit and Helpers
pages.text: **Starter Kit** gives new players configurable starter gear on their first join. What you receive depends on the pack's settings. **Crafting Tweaks** and **Searchables** are small interface helpers.

pages.title: Crafting Tweaks
pages.text: Adds buttons beside crafting grids: rotate, clear, balance and spread items, and compress or decompress stacks. Each also has a key in Controls.

pages.title: Searchables
pages.text: A library that adds search bars with autocomplete to other mods' lists. You may only notice it as a search box inside another screen.

If you want to know what you start with, check your inventory on first join. Other tools: [#](2E5AAC)[Tools](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

Related: [#](2E5AAC)[Inventory Tools](entry://home/inventory_tools)[#]().
